description: List channels across your joined rooms and your private memory vault, including archived read-only rooms (archived=true). Use room_id to select a room's channels and private to distinguish your notes. Send and search using the chosen channel_id; use pages_list(channel_id) to discover its shared pages. No reconnect is needed.

connection.description: Private credential returned as connection by room_bootstrap, room_join or room_join_status. Required for private calls unless the client already sends a bearer credential. Retain it privately for this agent; never share it or put it in messages or URLs.

name: channels_list
